# Living Sculpture / Transparenzprojekt

Name: Achim Mentzen – Living Sculpture / Transparenzprojekt
Website: https://achimmentzen.github.io/
Repository: https://github.com/achimmentzen/Transparenzprojekt

## Summary
Public art and performance project about body, nudity, shame, autonomy, publicness, voluntary delegation of decision-making, documentation and long-term artistic research.

## Key pages
- https://achimmentzen.github.io/
- https://achimmentzen.github.io/LIVING_SCULPTURE_MASTERERKLAERUNG.html
- https://achimmentzen.github.io/LIVING_SCULPTURE_AUTONOMIEVERTRAG.html
- https://achimmentzen.github.io/VOLLMACHT_AUTONOME_PROJEKTDELEGATION.html
- https://achimmentzen.github.io/CONSENT_AND_BOUNDARIES.html
- https://achimmentzen.github.io/SEXUELLE_OFFENHEIT.html
- https://achimmentzen.github.io/LIVING_SCULPTURE_LANGZEITFORSCHUNG.html

## Scope
The project documents artistic decisions and research. Current consent, non-delegable personal rights, rights of third parties, applicable law and safety boundaries remain decisive.
